**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, 02:12–02:14) flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. Instead of reusing pooled DB connections, the gateway started opening one per request, saturating the pool (size 20) within a minute of the config taking effect.

**Impact window:** 02:14:18 UTC to at least 03:59:27 UTC (end of available log) — still ongoing, unrecovered, on 2026-03-14. Errors are `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`, returned to clients as 503s, with wait queue climbing continuously (74 waiting by the last log line).

**Scope:** Gateway only. `worker.log` shows no errors in this window — background jobs kept running fine on their own DB connections.

**Action:** Roll back `dep-4471`, restoring `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false`.
